description: A 1998 home: calendar and seasonal rules only, Common practice labelling, no meters.

staticPack.title: Replace HVAC filter
staticPack.description: Every season, sooner with pets. A clogged filter is the most common cause of a struggling system.

staticPack.title: HVAC service
staticPack.description: Spring and fall — before the cooling and heating seasons.

staticPack.title: Clean gutters
staticPack.description: Spring and fall. Overflowing gutters send water into the foundation.

staticPack.title: Smoke & CO detector batteries
staticPack.description: Replace the batteries and press the test button on every unit.

staticPack.title: Flush water heater
staticPack.description: Drains the sediment that shortens the tank's life and its efficiency.

staticPack.title: Clean dryer vent
staticPack.description: Lint in the duct is a fire risk, not just a slow dryer.

staticPack.title: Refrigerator water filter
staticPack.description: Or per the fridge's own indicator.

staticPack.title: Sprinkler blowout
staticPack.description: Before the first freeze, if the house has an irrigation system.

staticPack.title: Chimney sweep & inspection
staticPack.description: If the house has a wood-burning fireplace or stove. Creosote is a fire risk.

staticPack.title: Septic pump-out
staticPack.description: If the house is on septic. Every three to five years depending on household size.
